scope: The authors provide original node masks and source station assignments under the IASLC 2009 scheme. Source station labels refer to these individual masks. Boundary geometry for entire nodal stations remains outside the supplied dataset. Source conflicts and undefined assignments are retained verbatim.
transform: The reader transports every author NIfTI sample without resampling, reversing y in both CT and masks for display orientation. 3D surfaces use the exterior faces of original labelled voxel cells. At acquisition edges, a face bounds the available mask grid.
